user.title: Configure SMN Weather
user.description: Set up the Servicio Meteorológico Nacional (SMN) weather integration.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to SMN. Please check your internet connection and try again.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

get_alerts.name: Get weather alerts
get_alerts.description: Get current weather alerts and warnings for the configured location from SMN. Returns active alerts with severity levels, descriptions, and instructions for use in automations.

config_entry_id.name: Config Entry ID
config_entry_id.description: Optional. The Home Assistant config entry ID (not the location ID). Leave empty to use your default SMN integration. Find this ID in Settings > Devices & Services > SMN > three dots > Download diagnostics.

get_alerts_for_location.name: Get alerts for specific location
get_alerts_for_location.description: Fetch weather alerts for any SMN location ID. Returns active alerts with severity levels, descriptions, and instructions.

location_id.name: Location ID
location_id.description: The SMN location ID to fetch alerts for. Example: 4864 for Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires.
